newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * United States President Bill Clinton is expected to arrive to Bucharest on Friday, more than 20 years after the last visit by an American head of state to the Balkan country.
* Romanian president Emil Constantinescu is attending a summit of East European leaders in Salzburg on regional security issues, after NATO's Madrid summit.
* A bill amending a 1991 land restitution law will be discussed after the parliament's summer recess.
